🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (P0 · swat-bypass)
Channel: swat → routed here (never posted into #swat)  •  bug-type guess: code (deploy regression)  •  alerts in group: 2
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `@connect` / `#team-connect` (Connect — Accounting Sync / QBDT)

Symptoms:
  • QBDT *sales tax resets to 0 on Save* (estimates/invoices, stock + custom screens) although tax is selected at the customer and item level.
  • ≥4 accounts reported: topstitchoffloridainc2, shedsunlimited, excelpoolservice (20 licenses), lappstructures — Jira notes "all big accounts," I1 impact, all users per account affected ("+1, keep adding").

Likely cause: today's release regressed the QBDT sales-tax-on-save calculation → tax zeroed before persistence. SILENT failure (HTTP 200 with the wrong value), so no Datadog error-rate/latency/5XX monitor fired — only support tickets + swat surfaced it. Connect team is already reverting (per swat thread).
Suggested next action: await/confirm the revert (in progress); verify with a taxable-transaction save canary (assert tax != 0, e.g. account m11rnqbdt); file the post-incident defect once the offending build is confirmed; add a sales-tax-on-save SLO canary to close the monitoring blind spot.
